## Walkthrough

Adds TypeScript typing and build support across CLI scripts, refactors several bin/* scripts with stronger types and generic APIs, updates a disassemble call to include a new HasMetadata parameter, removes an obsolete wrapper, and adds tsconfig + package.json script changes.

## Changes

| Cohort / File(s) | Change Summary |
|---|---|
| **Fuzz CLI & helpers** <br> `bin/fuzz.ts` | Strengthened TypeScript types: `fuzz(data: Uint8Array | number[])`, generic `assert<T>`, typed helpers (`programHex`, `linkTo`, `normalizeStatus`, `alsoAsHex`), and explicit test-case types (`InitialValues`, `ExpectedValues`, `writeTestCase`). |
| **Disassemble / CLI entry** <br> `bin/index.ts` | Imports `HasMetadata` and updates `disassemble(Array.from(f), kind)` → `disassemble(Array.from(f), kind, HasMetadata.No)`. |
| **Test runner / JSON processing** <br> `bin/test-json.ts`, `bin/test-gas-cost.ts`, `bin/test-w3f.ts` | Introduces `ProcessableData`, `TestOptions`, generic `run<T extends ProcessableData>`, `readFromStdin<T>`, `processFile<T>`; tighter typings throughout (BigInt casts, typed status mapping, explicit option types), and local type aliases (e.g., `PvmTest`, `Chunk`, `Page`, `Access`). |
| **Removed wrapper** <br> `bin/wrap.js` | Deleted script that constructed and printed fuzzed programs. |
| **Build & tooling** <br> `package.json`, `tsconfig.json` | Adds TypeScript tooling: `tsconfig.json`, uses `tsx` runners in npm scripts, adds `tsbuild` (tsc) to build pipeline, and new devDependencies (`typescript`, `tsx`, `@types/node`). |
| **Web helper** <br> `web/bump-version.ts` | File reads use explicit 'utf8' encoding and parsed JSON objects given tighter runtime typing for `{ version: string }`. |
| **Config** <br> `biome.jsonc` | JSONC schema URL bumped from 2.2.5 → 2.2.6. |
